facts.text: Andrew mentions that he hopes to take a German Shepherd on hiking trips because they are smart and loyal.

evidence.quote: I hope so! I shold take him hiking with me, they would be great hiking buddies, so smart and loyal.
German Shepherds are known for their loyalty and smarts. They love new journeys and would love exploring the outside with you.

facts.text: Audrey confirms that German Shepherds are known for their loyalty and intelligence, and that they enjoy exploring new environments.

evidence.quote: German Shepherds are indeed awesome! They are super loyal and smart.
German Shepherds are known for their loyalty and smarts. They love new journeys and would love exploring the outside with you.

facts.text: Audrey suggests that German Shepherds require a significant amount of attention and physical activity, such as walking and exploring.

evidence.quote: My advice would be to make sure you have enough time and energy for a pup - they need lots of attention and walks! Especially for a German Shepherd like Toby, he'll need to offset a lot of energy.
